description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, solid-color previews, scene restoration, credential-safe configuration backup and restore, concurrent multi-room playback, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance, color scene, execution, channel, and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, seek recovery, startup recovery, multi-session telemetry, and auto-reconnection.
